storyboard.concept: Ruby elegance meets diamond brilliance in premium jewellery showcase

scenes.visual: Complete ruby and diamond jewellery set - necklace and earrings - displayed on elegant surface, deep red gemstones catching light
scenes.background: Soft white silk surface with gentle folds, warm golden light from above, cream backdrop with subtle texture
scenes.vo: Asli rubies aur diamonds ka perfect combination - yeh hai real luxury

scenes.visual: Close-up of ruby stones in diamond halo settings, intricate metalwork and brilliant cut details visible
scenes.background: Smooth marble surface with subtle veining, soft directional lighting creating depth, blurred warm background
scenes.vo: Har stone hand-selected hai - premium craftsmanship jo dikhta hai clearly

scenes.visual: Full elegant display of both necklace and earrings arranged beautifully, showing complete set coordination
scenes.background: Rich velvet surface in deep burgundy, soft studio lighting with subtle shadows, luxurious depth
scenes.vo: Apne collection mein add karo - timeless beauty jo generations tak chalegi

storyboard.notes: Clean premium showcase highlighting the ruby and diamond craftsmanship without making unverified claims. Varied camera movements and elegant staging create aspirational appeal while letting the product quality speak for itself.
